in_marathi.name: Lochan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lochan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word "Lokha" meaning 'multitude' or 'many' and the word "Anna" meaning 'radiant' or 'shining'. Lochan is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology, often associated with gods and wise sages. It signifies a bright and shining soul, filled with knowledge and wisdom.
